item.text:
Mistral AI lists these commonly supported SAML identity providers:

- Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory)
- Google Workspace / Google Identity Platform
- Okta

Yes. Mistral states that **any SAML-compliant identity provider can work**, so you can use a different provider. You’ll need to configure it as a SAML 2.0 application using Mistral’s ACS URL, Entity ID, metadata, and required attribute mappings. OIDC is not supported for Organization SSO.

[ Mistral SAML SSO documentation ](https://docs.mistral.ai/admin/set-up-organization/sign-in-method/saml-sso) · [Mistral SSO configuration guide](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/quickstarts/admin/configure-sso)
